name: codearena-platform
description: CodeArena — Production-Grade Coding Education, Practice, Collaboration & Online Judge Platform

scripts.dev:local: bun run dev:backend & bun run dev:worker & bun run dev:frontend
scripts.typecheck: (cd backend && bun x tsc --noEmit) && (cd worker && bun x tsc --noEmit) && (cd frontend && bun x tsc --noEmit)
scripts.test: (cd backend && bun test) && (cd worker && bun test) && (cd frontend && bun test)
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:rbac
